messages:
Lauren (Customer Success): Heads-up: Invoice #4920 for Meridian Clinics failed card auth this morning, decline code `do_not_honor`. Customer needs access today and can do a wire or ACH. Can we retry or offer wire instructions?

billing-bot: [payment.failed] invoice=4920 customer=MeridianClinics provider=Stripe code=do_not_honor id=pi_4Lx... log="card_decline_do_not_honor"

Maria (Finance): We can run one manual retry now, then offer Plaid ACH link or wire. If they want ACH but their bank blocks micro-deposits, we accept bank letter or bank-stamped PDF for manual verification. Share billing email so I can send the secure link.

Sam (Ops): FYI: don't do back-to-back card auths within 5 minutes or gateways will flag it. Our automated retry schedule is 24h/72h. Manual retry okay if you need immediate confirmation.

Jordan (Sales): Hold onboarding until payment clears or we get a wire confirmation screenshot. If they wire today, we can fast-track provisioning and remove the late fee. Tell them that helps.

Lauren (Customer Success): billing@meridian.example. I told them we can accept wire copy. They replied they tried Plaid and got an "unsupported account type" error (savings acct). They can initiate wire and send the bank's outgoing transfer confirmation.

Maria (Finance): Send this secure wire template (paste into an encrypted email):

```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Redwood National Bank
ACH Routing: 061000104
Account #: 987654321
SWIFT/BIC: RNBUS33
Payment reference: INVOICE 4920 / Meridian Clinics
```

Maria (Finance): Request that they include the payer name and our invoice number on the wire. When they email the bank confirmation (PDF/screenshot showing amount, routing, sender and timestamp), we can mark invoice as "paid pending settlement" in QuickBooks and proceed with provisioning. I'll also add an AR note to suppress auto-reminders.

Sam (Ops): If you want me to flip the manual retry after they attempt wire (to see if card goes through), I can. But per above, wait 5	60m after the last decline.

Lauren (Customer Success): Sent secure wire template to billing@meridian.example and asked them to reply with the bank confirmation file. They said they will wire within 2 hours and will attach the SWIFT confirmation.

Jordan (Sales): Thanks Lauren. If they attach confirmation here I can approve the provisioning hold and loop infra.

Lauren (Customer Success): They just uploaded the SWIFT copy to the secure thread (forwarded to me). Screenshot shows outgoing wire, amount $12,450, timestamp 2026-03-23 10:12 UTC, and transaction ref ABC123XYZ. Posting redacted proof to this thread for ops to see.

Maria (Finance): Got it. I'll mark invoice 4920 as paid pending settlement and create a QuickBooks manual payment entry. Release pending tasks in 30m unless finance flag appears.

Sam (Ops): Noted. I'll kick provisioning after Maria's note.

Jordan (Sales): Great, pushing through. :tada:
